title: Guadalajara Cathedral

buildingCutout.basis: Cathedral way only. The Sagrario remains a separate building.

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified Plaza Guadalajara elevation immediately west of the principal cathedral entrance.

identities.name: Guadalajara Cathedral
identities.address: Avenida Alcalde 10, Centro, Guadalajara, Jalisco, México

mapIdentity.scope: The named mapped building and the large neighboring Sagrario form two separate polygons. The western frontage, east attachment, plaza orientation and tower setting are fixed by the mapped cathedral ring and both photographs.

note: The 2016 UNAM geotechnical study reports the different heights and 12 metre structural base widths of the two towers. The Secretariat of Culture identifies the modern replacement spires. The diocesan text establishes the basilican three-nave plan. Two public-domain views establish the spires and western facade details.
